item.name: 🧭 Maps Directions ✅

graphql.query:
query MapsDirections {
  mapsDirections(request: {
    startAddr: "Times Square, New York, NY"
    endAddr: "Central Park, New York, NY"
    travelMode: 1
    distanceUnit: 0
    avoid: "tolls"
    hl: "en"
    gl: "us"
  }) {
    searchMetadata {
      id
      status
      googleMapsDirectionsUrl
      totalTimeTaken
    }
    searchParameters {
      engine
      startAddr
      endAddr
      startDataId
      endDataId
      startCoords
      endCoords
      travelMode
      distanceUnit
      avoid
      prefer
      hl
      gl
    }
    placesInfo
    directions
    durations
    error
  }
}

graphql.query:
query ExploreFlightDestinations {
  flightExplore(request: {
    departureId: "JFK"
    arrivalAreaId: "/m/02j9z"
    month: 6
    travelDuration: 2
    travelClass: 1
    adults: 1
    stops: 2
    maxPrice: 600
    gl: "us"
    hl: "en"
    currency: "USD"
  }) {
    searchMetadata {
      id
      status
      totalTimeTaken
    }
    searchParameters {
      engine
      departureId
      arrivalId
      arrivalAreaId
      gl
      hl
      currency
      type
      outboundDate
      returnDate
      month
      travelDuration
      travelClass
      adults
      children
      infantsInSeat
      infantsOnLap
      stops
      travelMode
      interest
      includeAirlines
      bags
      maxPrice
      maxDuration
    }
    startDate
    endDate
    destinations {
      destinationId
      name
      country
      gpsCoordinates {
        latitude
        longitude
      }
      thumbnail
      destinationAirport {
        code
        id
        name
        location
      }
      startDate
      endDate
      flightPrice
      hotelPrice
      flightDuration
      numberOfStops
      airline
      airlineCode
      link
      serpApiLink
    }
    flights {
      departureAirport {
        code
        id
        name
        location
      }
      arrivalAirport {
        code
        id
        name
        location
      }
      duration
      price
      cheapestFlight
      numberOfStops
      airline
      airlineCode
    }
  }
}
